inj.note: Skattebo reportedly pushed to play Sunday, but reporters.com reported shortly before inactives were released that Skattebo would not suit up Sunday, and the second-year back was indeed ruled out for Week 9. With fellow running back Tyrone Tracy (hamstring) already sidelined, Devin Singletary will be the top option in the Giants' backfield, Phil Mafah -- also per Raanan -- will "likely be the next man up" and Greg Desrosiers will also be available as needed.

news.h: Giants' Cam Skattebo doubtful vs. Eagles; Malik Nabers 'full go'
news.d: Giants running back Cam Skattebo is unlikely to play against the Eagles on Sunday, but receiver Malik Nabers is expected to be a "full go" without limitations.
